verdict.rationale: An admin audit log is a fair question for a collaborative workspace SaaS like Notion, but nothing in the evidence documents a workspace audit log for reviewing actions. The nearest items don't qualify. Agent session 'event history' covers a different feature. Page-change webhooks are a developer building block. Workspace owners managing MCP access in Settings is an adjacent admin control.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
